video.title: Decode Your Secret AWS Bill
video.script: You got the AWS invoice. Four hundred bucks. But where did it go. Was it compute, storage, network, something you forgot you spun up three months ago. Most people stare at that PDF and just pay it. This thing reads your bill like a human and tells you exactly which service tanked your budget, then gives you the command to shut it down. No signup, nothing leaves your browser. Link in the description.
